Automated service lets you get through all the steps (entering DOB, phone number etc.) then cuts you off saying it's not working.  'Triage' puts you in a queue then cuts you off.  Reception line is broken up so you can't have a proper conversation.

After all that I thought I'd drive to the surgery to book an appointment, only to be told by the reception team that the doctors look after their own diaries and the only thing I can do is ring.

Massively frustrating for me, but what about anyone suffering from mental health difficulties or an elderly person?  Absolutely no care for the patient anymore.
